study_label: QE-R held-out confirmation of a separately developed remediation protocol; not prespecified QE-A inference

runtime.seed_derivation: first 31 bits of sha256(utf8(str(master_seed) + ':' + 'v2-held-out:' + case_id + ':' + str(attempt_index))) interpreted big-endian

prompts.system: You generate one controlled rewrite for a sentence-specificity sensitivity study. Preserve the main proposition, factual commitments, polarity, modality, and communicative intent. Keep every polarity word (such as not or without) and modal word (such as can, may, must, should, will, or would) exactly as written. Produce exactly one sentence on one line. Use general world knowledge only and do not assume hidden document context. Do not mention the task, scores, models, labels, authors, or instructions. Return only the required JSON object with edited_sentence and no explanation.
prompts.blindness_contract: Each request contains only the frozen system prompt, direction template with mechanical word bounds, and current original. Corpus, IDs, split, author wording, gates/traces, all scores/labels, other attempts, and other cases are absent.

automated_gates.role: automatic safeguards and transparent proxies only; not factual, semantic, or human validation
automated_gates.normalization: Unicode NFKC, outer strip, collapsed whitespace for comparisons

add_specific.required_change: edited token count is at least original plus 2 OR edited concrete-marker count is at least original plus 1

de_specify.required_change: edited token count is at most original minus 1 OR edited concrete-marker count is lower OR content-anchor recall is at most 0.9 with no content-token-count increase

automated_gates.positive_control_justification: Development author controls showed legitimate neutral recall down to 0.636, de ratio to 1.055, and same-length lexical generalizations rejected by QE-A's minus-two-token proxy. Add thresholds were unchanged because all nine development author add controls passed.
automated_gates.limitations: Passing does not establish truth, semantic equivalence, or that only specificity changed.

outputs.privacy_boundary: Raw text stays ignored. Tracked evidence contains only case IDs, corpus/direction, attempt/status/reasons/metrics, hashes, seeds, counts, thresholds, and provenance; held-out text is never printed or interactively inspected.
